# Protected conditional constructor arguments

Owned Java 8 fixture for allocation before a type-test branch and repeated getter,
a committed reference assignment before a wide argument, constructor failures,
catch input identity and finally exception replacement. Each original class,
immutable caller and DEX is frozen. The runner recompiles every generated source,
compares complete metadata and executes source-owned and SDK declaration routes
against an independent observer. No external application data is included.
